description: Use when a component's Figma design must be reviewed BEFORE any code exists — a new UI component, a design handoff, a spec artifact, or a request to review a design against the existing components. Symptoms include no implementation file yet, only a Figma node id or a spec markdown, and open questions about semantics, accessible names, alt text, disabled states, or state variants. Not the implementation-parity gate run against code that already exists.
